title: Demand Feature Vector Query
description: Filters for the Japan Anime Figure Demand Feature Vectors dataset. All fields are optional; omit to return the top 100 SKUs by demand score.

figureIds.title: Figure IDs
figureIds.description: Optional list of upstream figure IDs to restrict the result set.

series.title: Series
series.description: Filter by series name (partial, case-insensitive match).

character.title: Character
character.description: Filter by character name (partial, case-insensitive match).

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.description: Filter by manufacturer name (partial, case-insensitive match).

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Restrict to specific upstream categories (e.g. Scale Figure, Anime Figure).

minDemandScore.title: Minimum Demand Score
minDemandScore.description: Only return SKUs whose composite demand score is >= this value (0.0-1.0).

maxDemandScore.title: Maximum Demand Score
maxDemandScore.description: Only return SKUs whose composite demand score is <= this value (0.0-1.0).

hasPriceOnly.title: Has Price Only
hasPriceOnly.description: Skip SKUs with no observed price data (522 of 654 rows have no live offers).

requireOfferDetail.title: Require Offer Detail
requireOfferDetail.description: Only return SKUs whose upstream row carries a populated offers[] array. Recommended when you rely on per-shop features (shop_price_cv, distinct_shop_norm, instock_price_premium): 181 upstream rows advertise an aggregate offer count but ship no offer detail, so those features are 0 for them.

includeFeatures.title: Include Named Features
includeFeatures.description: Attach the named feature dictionary and feature-name list to each record.

includeVector.title: Include Ordered Vector
includeVector.description: Attach the canonical ordered 48-dimensional float vector to each record.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Pagination offset (records are ordered by descending demand score, then figure ID).
